channel.title: The Drill Down: Minnesota Vikings
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 12: Falcons at Vikings
item.description: Sun 11/29 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: MIN -7 · O/U 42.5 | Model MIN 65% vs. market 73% | Atlanta's offense ranks 30th in EPA per dropback against the blitz, and Minnesota's defense ranks 3rd at stopping it, so the Falcons must handle pressure early. Drake London absorbs 28% of Atlanta's targets and 37% of its air yards, but he runs into a Minnesota pass defense ranked first in the league. Our model has Minnesota at 65% against a 73% market price, agreeing on the side but seeing less certainty, with the passing matchup and starting quarterback driving the number.

item.title: Week 11: Vikings at 49ers
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 8:20 PM ET | Line: SF -3 · O/U 46.5 | Model SF 79% vs. market 64% | Minnesota's pass rush, first in the league at 28% pressure, has to beat a San Francisco pass protection that ranks 8th, and that trade decides whether Brock Purdy stays comfortable in the pocket. Justin Jefferson, who takes 29% of Minnesota's targets, runs into a San Francisco pass defense that ranks 6th, while Purdy's edge over Kirk Cousins runs wide. Our model sits well above the market on San Francisco, driven mainly by a rushing matchup worth 4.7 points toward the 49ers.

item.title: Week 10: Vikings at Packers
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: GB -2.5 · O/U 42.5 | Model GB 72% vs. market 57% | The game turns on whether Minnesota's front can reach Jordan Love, since Minnesota's 25% pressure rate ranks first and Green Bay's offense ranks fourth in EPA per dropback. Matthew Golden absorbs 29% of Green Bay's targets, and he runs into a Minnesota pass defense ranked third. Our model has Green Bay at 72% against a market number of 57%, driven mostly by the passing matchup.
